edges.reason: White concrete is sealed inside a bedrock enclosure; the ONLY accessible face is blocked by cyan terracotta. Player must mine cyan terracotta to physically reach and mine the white concrete.
Jungle trapdoor is placed inside the sealed enclosure behind the white concrete layer. Player must mine white concrete (inner wall) to reach the trapdoor mounted on the back wall of the chamber.
Acacia door requires a 2x3 pattern (6 planks) in a 3x3 crafting grid. Player must mine the crafting table, pick it up, place it, and use it to craft the door.
The barrel is hidden inside an enclosed alcove behind the quartz stairs structure. The only entrance is a 1-block-wide gap on the west side requiring navigation around the stairs.
